title: Real Estate Lead Management: Stop Losing Enquiries

faqs.question: Why do real estate companies lose 60% of their online leads?
faqs.answer: The primary cause is delayed response time.

faqs.question: What is the 5-minute lead response rule in real estate?
faqs.answer: Research proves that contacting a digital real estate lead within 5 minutes increases the odds of qualifying the buyer by 21x compared to waiting 30 minutes. After 1 hour, the probability of booking a site visit drops by 80%.

faqs.question: How does WhatsApp automation improve lead qualification?
faqs.answer: An automated WhatsApp flow instantly delivers project brochures, price ranges, and floor plans, while asking 2 qualifying questions (budget and timeline) before handing the lead to a senior sales executive.

faqs.question: What are the essential CRM stages for property sales?
faqs.answer: A standard real estate pipeline must include: New Enquiry, WhatsApp Verified, Contacted / Qualified, Site Visit Scheduled, Site Visit Completed, Negotiation / EOI, and Booking Closed.

faqs.question: Why do sales executives hate manual Excel lead sheets?
faqs.answer: Excel sheets lack automated reminders, click-to-call dialing, and duplicate detection.

faqs.question: How can builders prevent leads from getting recycled by brokers?
faqs.answer: Deploy a centralized cloud lead engine with automatic timestamping and duplicate checking. When a lead enters from any source, it is permanently locked to the first originating channel partner.

faqs.question: What is an acceptable lead-to-site-visit ratio in North India?
faqs.answer: For mid-income residential projects (₹60L–₹1.5Cr) in UP and NCR, a well-managed lead funnel achieves a 10% to 15% site visit ratio from total qualified digital leads.

faqs.question: Can WhatsApp chatbots replace human sales agents in real estate?
faqs.answer: No. The chatbot's role is strictly speed-to-lead: instant brochure delivery and initial qualification. Closing high-value property transactions will always require skilled human empathy and negotiation on-site.
